request_text: Kitchen tap drips constantly, been like this about two weeks. Not urgent but annoying at night.
Found a puddle about 2 m wide around the domestic hot water tank. Tank is making a knocking noise.
Please install a 3 m wall-mounted shelving unit in our storage room. We will supply the unit.
Chain on one of the swings is broken.
Toilet runs on and off all night. Water bill went up last month.
I heard sparking when I pressed the garage door opener and now the garage has no power.
Fire alarm sounded at 3 am. Residents silenced it, no fire seen. Panel says zone 4.
Badge reader at the main entrance isn't reading cards. People are propping the door open.
We need 4 extra outlets for new workstations. Move-in is Dec 1.
Garbage room smells and there are flies everywhere.
Fire alarm panel has shown a trouble light for two days.
Marker graffiti on the stairwell wall.
Cold draft around the balcony door.
Window seal has failed on 3 windows. Condensation between the panes.
Burning smell from the living room outlet. The outlet is warm and has gone brown around the edges.
Smoke detector chirps every minute. Probably the battery.
About half of the lights on P2 are out. Evening staff don't feel safe walking to their cars.
Lawn hasn't been cut in three weeks.
No hot water since this morning. I have a toddler at home.
Server room AC alarm shows 31C with the door closed. Our equipment will start shutting down soon.
Seeing cockroaches in the kitchen at night. Several. Neighbour says they have them too.
Stair handrail has pulled away from the wall a bit.
A fence panel fell down along the east boundary after the wind.
Breaker keeps tripping when the microwave and kettle run together.
Two of the four toilets are not flushing. Staff are going down to the 3rd floor and queueing.
Door doesn't close fully so anyone can walk in. The magnetic lock isn't holding.
Wasp nest under the front porch roof. Kids play there.
Bathroom exhaust fan makes a grinding sound and doesn't pull steam out.
Fist-sized hole in the hallway drywall from a door handle.
Parking gate arm is stuck in the up position. It won't close overnight.
Sprinkler comes on at 2 am and floods the path.
Doorbell does not work.
Multiple nail pops in the living room ceiling drywall.
Rats seen near the garbage bins at the loading dock.
Boardroom table leg is loose and the table wobbles. Client meeting on Thursday.
Wet leaves are clogging the walkways and they are very slippery.
Standing water on the roof near the hatch. Drain looks blocked.
Paint is peeling on the bathroom ceiling above the shower and there are black spots.
Fire extinguisher is missing from its cabinet in the corridor.
Neighbour's tree branches are touching my roof.
Lost my fob for the building door. Please deactivate it and issue a new one.
Outdoor AC unit is making a loud rattling noise when it runs.
Three light fixtures are out in the corridor beside the stairwell. It is dark at night.
Need the suite re-keyed after an employee left.
Planters are dead. Please replace for fall.
Thermostat screen is blank and we can't adjust the temperature.
Scuff marks on walls after a furniture move. Touch up whenever convenient.
Scratching noises in the attic at night. Might be a raccoon.
Keypad code for the visitor gate isn't working for my guests.
Hallway smoke alarm was removed during painting last week and never put back.
Fire extinguisher tag shows it expired in 2023.
Shower head is loose and spraying sideways. Pressure is also low.
Kitchen cabinet door fell off its hinge.
I think the furnace filter has not been changed in over a year. Can someone swap it?
Water comes in around the window frame during heavy rain and soaks the carpet.
Balcony railing wobbles when leaned on. One post feels loose at the base.
Found mouse droppings in the kitchenette cupboards.
Closet sliding door came off its track.
Ants in the kitchen every morning, trailing in from the window.
Outdoor tap leaks at the base whenever a hose is connected.
Waking up with bites on my arms and I found small dark spots along the mattress seam.
Pothole about 30 cm wide near the visitor entrance.
Furnace will not start. Thermostat says heat is on but only cold air comes out. It is 2 degrees outside and my elderly mother lives with me.
Exit sign above the east stairwell door is not lit.
No power at the kitchen outlets only. Rest of the house is fine. I checked the breaker panel.
Laminate is peeling at the edge of the reception desk.
Stairwell fire door is propped open with a wedge. Smokers are doing it.
Several shingles blew off last night. Found them in the courtyard.
Water stain on the top floor bedroom ceiling after yesterday's rain. It is getting bigger.

A siding panel is cracked beside the garage.
Paint is chipped beside the elevator.
Weatherstripping on the loading dock door is torn and wind blows in.
CO detector went off briefly this morning near the furnace. It stopped on its own.
Sprinkler head is dripping slightly. One drip every few seconds.
Kitchenette sink is draining slowly. Probably coffee grounds.
A back deck board broke and my son's foot went through it. He's okay, just scraped. Other boards look soft too.
Faint rotten egg smell near the furnace closet. Comes and goes.
East side is freezing, people are wearing coats. Been like this since Monday.
Dark patches on the wall behind the pantry fridge. Might be mould.
Basement floor drain is gurgling and there is a bad sewage smell after the neighbour ran laundry.
Eavestrough overflows at the front corner and pours onto the walkway.
Front door doesn't latch properly. I have to lift the handle to lock it.
Key broke off in the mailbox lock.
A few fruit flies around our office plants.
Large tree branch fell across the visitor parking and blocks four spots.

Locked out with my keys inside. It's 9 pm and I have a baby.
Outlet cover is cracked and the wires are visible behind it.

Bedroom ceiling has a crack about a metre long and bits of plaster are falling.
Third and fifth stair steps squeak loudly.
Gap in the soffit near the roof edge. Birds are going in and out.
Heat only works on the main floor. Upstairs bedrooms are cold.
Whole unit needs repainting before the new tenant moves in on the 15th.
Heard mice in the walls last week and caught one in the pantry.
Water stain is spreading on a ceiling tile near the washroom.
Pot lights in the lobby are flickering and a few are buzzing.
Deadbolt is stiff and hard to turn, but it still works.
